Venue: Gate
Headline: Gate Prediction Markets Top Five Leagues Challenge: Share 40,000 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Matches continue across the Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, and Ligue 1. Register for the Top Five Leagues Prediction Challenge. Earn 10 USDT for each qualifying friend you invite. Complete 10 match prediction challenges to earn rewards. New Prediction Markets users can also compete on the trading leaderboard for a share of 20,000 USDT.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 25, 2026, 08:00 (UTC) – December 23, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Participation Method and Scope of Statistics
This event covers all Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, and Ligue 1 matches listed on Gate Prediction Markets. Champions League, Europa League, other cup matches, and other events are excluded. Register on the event page and complete Identity Verification before making predictions with your own funds. Trading volume generated with Prediction Markets Trading Vouchers or other funds that are not your own does not count.
## Reward 1: Invite Friends to Make Their First Prediction and Share 10,000 USDT
After registering for the event, invite friends to create their first Gate account through the event-exclusive link. Each friend must complete Identity Verification and event registration, then make their first prediction on a match in the top five leagues. Once they reach at least 100 USDT in cumulative eligible trading volume and use 5 Event Points scratch cards, you will receive 10 USDT for that qualifying friend.
Each referrer can earn up to 5 rewards, totaling up to 50 USDT. Rewards are available for the first 1,000 qualifying referrals across the platform, awarded on a first-come, first-served basis according to when each friend completes all tasks. Each friend counts as only one qualifying referral.
## Reward 2: Predict 10 Different Matches and Share 10,000 USDT
After registering for the event, new and existing users can complete this task by making predictions on 10 different matches in the top five leagues, reaching at least 100 USDT in cumulative eligible trading volume per match, and using a total of 50 Event Points scratch cards. Multiple prediction markets for the same match count as one match.
The first 1,000 eligible users to complete all tasks will each receive 10 USDT.
## Reward 3: New User Trading Leaderboard: Share 20,000 USDT
Users who have never completed a prediction trade on Gate Prediction Markets at the time of event registration can join the new user leaderboard. New users are ranked by cumulative eligible trading volume on matches in the top five leagues, from highest to lowest. You must meet both the trading volume and scratch card thresholds for your tier. Rewards are allocated based on your eligible trading volume as a share of the total eligible trading volume of all qualifying users in that tier. The table below sets out the rewards:
Rank | Tier Prize Pool | Minimum Cumulative Eligible Trading Volume | Minimum Scratch Cards Used
1st–5th Place | Share 5,000 USDT | 600,000 USDT | 30,000
6th–10th Place | Share 4,000 USDT | 400,000 USDT | 20,000
11th–20th Place | Share 3,000 USDT, up to 300 USDT per user | 200,000 USDT | 10,000
21st–500th Place | Share 8,000 USDT, up to 20 USDT per user | 10,000 USDT | 500
## Leaderboard Rules
To earn a tier reward, users must meet both the cumulative eligible prediction trading volume requirement and the required number of Prediction Points Scratch Cards used for that tier. Meeting only one requirement does not qualify a user for the tier reward.
Users are first checked against both requirements for the tier corresponding to their original rank. If either requirement is unmet, each lower tier is checked in order until the user reaches the first tier for which they meet both requirements. Moving to a lower reward tier does not change the user's original rank, reorder the leaderboard, or move other users up.
Users assigned to a lower tier share that tier's prize pool with its other qualifying users. As a result, the number of reward recipients in a tier may exceed the number of ranks listed for that tier in the table. Each user may receive a reward from only one leaderboard tier.
Individual reward = (the user's cumulative eligible prediction trading volume / the combined cumulative eligible prediction trading volume of all qualifying users in the tier) × the tier's prize pool, subject to the tier's per-user reward cap.
The per-user reward cap is 300 USDT for the tier covering ranks 11–20 and 20 USDT for the tier covering ranks 21–500. The same caps apply to users assigned to either tier from a higher tier.
If users have the same cumulative eligible prediction trading volume, the user who first reaches that volume and meets the minimum scratch card requirement ranks higher.
New users are those making their first-ever prediction on Prediction Markets. Anyone who made a prediction on another event before registering for the campaign does not qualify as a new user.
## Scratch Card Task Details
Only valid scratch cards used after you register and during the event period count. Cards earned in other Prediction Markets sections also count. In the "Top Five Leagues" section of Prediction Markets, you receive one scratch card for every 20 USDT traded.
When scratching cards in batches, each card used counts separately. The same valid scratch card can count toward all applicable rewards in this event. Rewards from this event cannot be combined with Event Points leaderboard rewards.
Use your cards before they expire. This event does not extend their validity. Unrevealed cards do not count.
For details, see Event Points and Scratch Card Rules.
## Prediction Markets Trading Voucher Rules
All rewards in this event are Prediction Markets Trading Vouchers. Vouchers cannot be withdrawn, transferred, or redeemed for cash. They can only be used to trade on Prediction Markets.
Profits generated from predictions using the vouchers can be withdrawn in accordance with the product rules.
Use vouchers within their stated validity period. Any unused balance expires automatically at the end of that period. Follow the usage requirements shown on each voucher.
## Important Notes
To receive rewards, register using [Join Now] on the event page and complete Identity Verification. Only designated users who meet the eligibility requirements can participate. If registration is unavailable, your account is not currently eligible. Refer to the event page for current eligibility details.
Only eligible trades made after you register, during the event period, and in the events specified on the event page count. Only trades made with your own funds qualify. Positions and returns generated with Prediction Markets Trading Vouchers or other subsidized funds are excluded.
Eligible trading volume is the actual filled value of prediction trades, including purchases of Yes, purchases of No, and sales on the secondary market. Unfilled orders, unfilled portions of canceled orders, transfers, refunds, and abnormal trades are excluded.
If an event is postponed, canceled, rescheduled, or interrupted, or if rulings change, markets close, or other force majeure circumstances arise, Gate may adjust, suspend, or cancel the affected markets and event rewards as appropriate.
All rewards are issued as Prediction Markets Trading Vouchers. Voucher principal cannot be withdrawn, transferred, or redeemed for cash. Profits generated with vouchers can be withdrawn under the product rules. The terms on each voucher determine the eligible markets, validity period, and how returns are handled.
After review and approval, rewards will be distributed within 14 business days after the event ends. If you also participate in other Gate events of the same type, you can receive rewards from only one event, subject to Gate's assessment and the rules on the event page.
Only one eligible main account per verified identity may participate. Subaccounts are not eligible. API users, users at VIP 15 or above, market makers, corporate accounts, institutional accounts, and restricted accounts are not eligible.
Gate Prediction Markets services may be restricted by the laws and regulations in your jurisdiction. You must comply with the Gate User Agreement. Before participating, review local laws and regulations and the platform's terms of service, assess your risk tolerance, and confirm that you are eligible. Users in restricted regions may be unable to access some or all services, including registration, trading, making predictions, claiming rewards, or participating in this event.
This event is not marketed to users in regions where prediction markets, prediction contests, contracts for difference, derivatives, or crypto asset trading are prohibited or restricted. Users must not use VPNs, proxies, false identities, third parties acting on their behalf, or other means to bypass regional restrictions, KYC requirements, or the platform's risk control rules.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
Gate reserves the right to adjust, suspend, or cancel the event rules, prize pool, reward distribution methods, eligibility, or event period without separate notice due to market conditions, changes to matches, system issues, compliance requirements, or force majeure. Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this event.

## 1. Participation Details
Users are deemed to have read and agreed to the Bitget Simple Earn Product Agreement.
Promotion rewards apply to main accounts only and are valid only during the promotion period. Institutional users are not currently eligible.
To view the Simple Earn APR boost promotion in the app, update the Bitget app to version V2.91.0 or later.
## 2. Net deposit calculation
Net deposit amount = deposit amount − withdrawal amount. Internal transfers are not counted.
The USDT activity tracks net deposits in USDT, USDC and USDGO, all converted to USDT for calculation. The BTC, ETH and XAUT activities track net deposits of the respective coins only.
## 3. Eligibility updates and effective time
The system checks each user's net deposits and subscriptions daily and automatically updates promotion eligibility between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM (UTC+8) the following day. Once eligibility is updated, the corresponding Simple Earn product starts earning the boost; users who do not meet the conditions receive the base APR only.
Both net deposit and interest accrual follow T+1 logic. For example, a subscription or net deposit completed between 11:00 PM and 11:59:59 PM (UTC+8) on day D is counted as of 12:00 AM on day D+1, and promotion eligibility is updated on day D+2.
## 4. Boost calculation and limits
Promotion rewards apply only to principal within each promotion's boost cap. Any amount above the cap does not earn the promotion boost.
Promotion rewards are calculated daily on the user's hourly average holdings from the previous day.
Redeeming principal during the promotion period may void your eligibility or affect the bonus APR you are currently earning.
Total promotion rewards are capped and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Individual rewards are also capped; once your individual cap is reached, no further promotion rewards will be granted.
